properties.name: La Pastora green-core pilot AOI
properties.purpose: Refined dense-green research AOI for M3b replication; excludes much of the stadium, dense residential fabric, and southern interchange visible in Sentinel QC
properties.source_note: Derived from visual QC of 2025/2026 Sentinel RGB; approximate research polygon, not an official park or protected-area boundary
properties.refinement_rationale: Focus the benchmark on the central vegetated corridor so M3b contrasts a denser-green site against mixed-urban Fundidora
